subject: Gateway Health — pen test report submission roadmap and redaction plan
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <security@gatewayhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request: redacted pen-test report + CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 intake (GH-GRC-9843)

Hi Jordan —

Hope you’re well. Gateway Health is running a SOC 2 intake for a new partner cohort and the GRC portal (ID: GH-GRC-9843) requires a penetration test report (redacted allowed) along with a CAIQ mapping and a findings index. Our deadline to accept artifacts for this cycle is 2027-11-08 EOD.

Can Redwood provide:
- A redacted penetration test report (PDF) suitable for external auditors
- A short CAIQ mapping summary to indicate which controls the pen test covers
- A CSV index of findings (severity, short description, remediation status)

Please let me know if you need a template for the CAIQ mapping or if you prefer to upload directly to our portal — I can grant your account an upload link. Also want to confirm whether the report will include any sample logs or PII we should expect to be redacted.

Thanks —
Elena Ortiz
Senior InfoSec Manager, Gateway Health
security@gatewayhealth.com

Attachment: GH-GRC-9843-intake-instructions.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <security@gatewayhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: redacted pen-test report + CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 intake (GH-GRC-9843)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the portal ID. We can provide a redacted version of the pen test report and the CAIQ mapping. High-level plan:

1) We will produce a redacted PDF that removes any customer-identifying data and sample logs — we replace detailed logs with summarized excerpts.
2) We’ll include a CAIQ mapping doc (one page) that lists the pen test coverage against common CAIQ items used in your intake.
3) We’ll export a findings index CSV (severity, short description, CWE where available, current remediation status).

Proposed timeline: upload to GH-GRC-9843 by 2027-11-04 EOD. If that works, we’ll follow with a remediation status update (ETA per finding) on 2027-11-18.

Attachments we intend to upload: pen_test_summary_redacted_v2.pdf, findings_index_20271101.csv, remediation_status_20271104.md

Questions for you:
- Are there any accept/reject criteria on your side for the redaction (e.g., must not remove CWE IDs)?
- Do you need a separate signed attestation for the redaction process?

Looping in Kim from our security team to coordinate the redaction checklist.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: proposed_upload_manifest.txt (attachment stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 10:02:20 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: redacted pen-test report + CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 intake (GH-GRC-9843)

Soojin — forwarding Gateway’s intake request. Proposed upload by Thursday (11/4). Can you review and approve the redaction checklist before we push?

Key items for review:
- Remove customer IPs and any full request/response log snippets; replace with 1–2 summarized examples per finding
- Keep CWE identifiers and severity labels intact
- Include a short remediation plan per medium/high finding (one-paragraph)

I attached our current redaction_checklist_v1.pdf. If you approve, I’ll confirm timeline with Gateway and do the upload.

Thanks —
Jordan

Attachment: redaction_checklist_v1.pdf (internal attachment)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 11:15:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: redacted pen-test report + CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 intake (GH-GRC-9843)

Thanks for the ping — I reviewed the checklist. Approve the redaction approach with the following required tweaks:

- Strip all sample logs and replace with a one-paragraph summary per affected finding.
- Do not remove CWE IDs, severity, or reproduction steps at the high-level (we can keep repro steps as pseudo-code).
- Add a short statement at the top of the PDF: "Redacted for external consumption — no customer-identifying data included."
- Set GRC metadata: has_pii = no, screening_scope = "external redacted report only"

Remediation guidance:
- Medium findings: target ETA two weeks from upload (2027-11-18).
- High findings: immediate remediation plan and ticket created in SEC-5421 (link attached).

Kim — can you prepare the CAIQ mapping (one page) and the findings CSV? I will sign off once the files match the checklist.

-Sooj

Attachment: SEC-5421 (Jira link) (internal reference)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <security@gatewayhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 15:22:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: redacted pen-test report + CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 intake (GH-GRC-9843) — files uploaded

Hi Elena —

Per our timeline, we uploaded the following artifacts to your GRC portal (GH-GRC-9843) a few minutes ago:

- pen_test_summary_redacted_v2.pdf (redactions applied per checklist; includes redaction statement)
- findings_index_20271101.csv (severity, CWE, short description, remediation status, ticket refs)
- caiq_mapping_gatewayhealth_20271104.pdf (one-page mapping)
- remediation_status_20271104.md (current ETA per finding)

Portal upload link: https://grc.gatewayhealth.com/portal/records/GH-GRC-9843 (you should have upload confirmation pending).

Notes:
- We confirmed no PII is present in the uploaded PDF and marked has_pii = false in the portal metadata.
- Medium finding remediation ETAs are targeted for 2027-11-18; high findings have tickets in SEC-5421 for immediate remediation.

If you need the redaction attestation signed, we can produce a brief signed statement. Also happy to run a short walkthrough (15 min) of the artifacts if your audit team wants quick context.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: pen_test_summary_redacted_v2.pdf (uploaded), findings_index_20271101.csv (uploaded), caiq_mapping_gatewayhealth_20271104.pdf (uploaded)

From: Elena Ortiz <security@gatewayhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 15:58:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: redacted pen-test report + CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 intake (GH-GRC-9843) — received

Jordan —

Thanks, I can see the uploads and the metadata looks correct. We’ll accept the redacted PDF for this intake.

Please ensure you update SEC-5421 ticket comments with remediation progress and ping me once medium items are closed (target 11/18). If you can provide a 10–15 minute walkthrough next week, that would help our auditor sign off faster.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Elena
notes: Internal: redaction sign-off obtained from Soojin; upload completed to Gateway Health GRC portal. Follow-up: remediation updates to SEC-5421 and optional walkthrough scheduling.
